jobs.title: Product Manager, API Platform
jobs.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

Our Product Managers imagine the ideal experience for our community and work backwards, creating innovative products that delight our guests and hosts. They deeply understand the needs of our users and translate these into a strategy that combines strong product thinking and deep research. They partner with talented cross-functional team members across engineering, design, operations, data science, and more, leading teams to execute a shared vision. They are incredibly detail-oriented and hands on.

The Difference You Will Make:

You will be part of the team responsible for product roadmaps and launches at Airbnb. You will  drive specific feature/s that are part of every launch and determine how they are communicated to the external world. You are responsible for the success of Airbnb products throughout their life cycle — from concept to release. And their cross-functional work ensures a consistent product voice across all the products being developed at Airbnb.

We are seeking a Product Manager for our API platform for hosts and developers. You will be responsible for working closely with our engineering team to build and deliver improvements to our API platform and tools for developers. You will own the product marketing for how our partners can use our API platform to create high value applications. You will partner with a cross functional team of account managers to scale adoption of our API platform features by existing and new partners. This is an exciting opportunity to shape the future of travel and leave a lasting impact on how the world explores and connects.

A Typical Day:

- Develop and maintain a product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the API platform.

- Synthesize feedback and translate it into product features.

- Develop a public and developer facing messaging and narrative for the API platform.

- Align product teams and cross functional partners.

- Develop partnerships with a focus on supply and demand.

- Role model behaviors that encourage open communication and curiosity.

- Make judgements and prioritization decisions that are in the best interests of our users.

- Efficiently execute to ship products and deliver impact for our business and users.

Your Expertise:

- 8+ years of product management and/or product marketing experience.

- 3+ years of product management experience designing and building developer platforms.

- Passionate about improving developer productivity, product quality, and automating/optimizing developer workflows.

- Demonstrated empathy for key developer pain points, and a track record of leadership in building products for developers.

- Experience building strategic relationships with partner executives, senior management and technical staff to achieve business goals.

- Experience creating product messaging and delivering to customers and the media.

- Demonstrated inbound and subject matter expertise.

- Be able to build compelling customer-focused stories and work with marketing and communications partners to bring them to life.

- Demonstrated track record of product leadership in a cross functional environment.

- Entrepreneurial track record of taking an idea to reality and leading teams through a dynamic environment.

- A strong ability to effectively use data and perform business analysis to support product strategy/decisions.

- Excited to drive execution across teams in a fast-paced environment.

- Enjoys doing individual contributor product management work and staying in the details.

- Strong ability and desire to travel frequently, including domestic and international.

Your Location:

We are open to candidates in multiple locations, but we ask that you are able to work Pacific Time Zone work hours as needed.

This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. Working closely with your cross-functional partners across the business and guest experience teams, you will own the roadmap for both evergreen discounts and targeted promotions that help hosts increase their earnings through more competitive prices and increased guest visibility. In addition, you will be working closely with our data science and analytics teams to develop the targeting and business strategy using programmatic Airbnb funded promotions and build the capabilities to execute these campaigns at scale.

Success is defined by how well our discounts and  promotions drive help hosts succeed in increasing earnings and also driving price competitiveness on Airbnb overall. To be successful, the right candidate will be deeply grounded in understanding host needs and concerns and able to distill those into simple, delightful products that are well received and effectively used.

- Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for discount and promotional pricing tools that help hosts win bookings and maximize earnings.

- Design the mechanics of promotional offers that balance host flexibility with guest value.

- Build the tools to deliver global, event-aligned promotional campaigns — tying discounts to demand moments and merchandising visibility in exchange for host participation.

- Architect a programmatic promotions engine that flexes pricing incentives by market, timing, and demand signal to close supply-demand gaps.

- Turn pricing and promotions data into a story — craft the narrative that gets hosts, partners, and internal teams bought into new discount tools.

- Set a high bar for product craft and quality — bring a sharp intuition for what makes a pricing or promotions experience feel great, not just function, and hold the roadmap, team, and cross-functional partners to that standard while shipping with speed and clear, measurable outcomes.

- Partner with Design and Eng to ship pricing features fast, and with FP&A, Marketing, Ops, and Trust to make sure promotions run cleanly at scale.

- Set sharp goals and OKRs for promotional adoption, discount redemption, and marketplace impact — then execute against them with urgency.

- Develop pricing and promotions expertise through host research, marketplace/booking data, and competitive benchmarking (e.g., dynamic pricing, coupon systems, flash sales in other marketplaces).

- 8+ years of product management experience.

- Experience with developing pricing tools especially around promotions in marketplaces.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Services
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA, Seattle WA, New York, NY
jobs.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. The Community You Will Join:

Our Product Managers imagine the ideal experience for our community and work backwards, creating innovative products that delight our guests and hosts. They partner with talented cross-functional team members across engineering, design, operations, data science, and more, leading teams to execute a shared vision. They are incredibly detail-oriented and hands on.

The Difference You Will Make:

Airbnb has always been about where you stay. Guest Services is about everything that makes a trip more convenient and special once you're there. A private chef cooking dinner in your home. A massage after a day of hiking. A photographer to capture the trip. Groceries waiting when you land, a ride from the airport, your bags stored between checkout and your flight, a car to explore beyond city limits. As Product Manager, Guest Services, you will help build an entirely new business line and a new reason for millions of guests to open Airbnb.

This is a rare opportunity to work on a genuine zero-to-one bet inside a company at global scale. The categories are still being defined, the playbook is still being written, and the ceiling is enormous: every trip is a chance to add a service, and every service is a chance to deepen why guests choose Airbnb. You'll partner closely with the teams building the supply side (hosts and partners), along with engineering, design, data science, and operations, to grow new categories from first bookings into thriving marketplaces.

A Typical Day:

- Define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for how guests discover, book, and enjoy services—from the first impression to the moment the chef arrives or the car is dropped off.

- Ship and iterate fast. Prototype and partner with engineering and design to build, launch experiments, read the results, and decide what to double down on and what to kill.

- Live in the data. Define the metrics that matter, like conversion, attach rate, repeat booking, guest satisfaction, and use them to find where guests drop off and where the biggest opportunities are.

- Obsess over the guest. Talk to guests, read the reviews and support tickets, take the bookings yourself. Bring the real, unfiltered voice of the guest into every prioritization conversation.

- Balance both sides of the marketplace. Partner with the supply and operations teams building the provider side, so that what's great for guests is also sustainable for the hosts and partners delivering the service.

- Drive clarity across orgs. Bring engineering, design, marketing, ops, legal, and leadership along with a clear strategy.

Your Expertise:

- 10+ years of consumer product management experience.

- Track record of taking 0→1 product ideas through incubation, piloting, and graduation to scaled products — at a consumer internet company, marketplace, or equivalent.

- Experienced builder: Ability to prototype using the latest AI tools to prove hypotheses and get user feedback quickly

- Strong business acumen: Ability to rapidly assess business viability, size opportunities, and translate loosely-defined hypotheses into testable MVP scopes.

- Comfort operating in ambiguity: Ability to structure new problem spaces into actionable roadmaps with minimal process.

- Experience managing multiple workstreams with competing priorities and tight timelines.

- Excellent cross-functional collaboration and communication skills across business, partnerships, engineering, design, and data science.

- Experience developing product narratives and working with marketing and communications to bring new offerings to market.

- Comfortable doing hands-on individual contributor product work and mastering the details in a scrappy environment.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Platform Product Management (Payments)
jobs.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

At Airbnb, we maintain and extend a world-class payments platform that is the engine of commerce and trust for our global community. This platform currently supports 220 countries and over 65 currencies, connecting dozens of payment providers and processing billions of dollars annually. To enable and support growth of the marketplace, we continually innovate unique ways for guests to pay for stays and experiences that are memorable and in many cases life changing.  Whether it's providing accepting relevant forms of payments, breaking payments into more manageable parts, or combining payments for several individuals seeking to travel and share together, Airbnb strives to make paying trips as simple as possible, while protecting our guests and hosts with security and assurances we have their backs every step of the way.

The Difference You Will Make:

Within the payment organization, the platform team comprises individuals that manage our products and experiences related to checkout, payment methods, risk, compliance, and hosts payouts.  We are seeking a strong Senior Platform leader to manage all aspects of our guest payment capabilities and experiences.  This includes enabling new global and local payment methods, onboarding and validating methods with our processing partners, managing post transaction interactions such as refunds and transaction reporting, and finally creating and expanding our growing portfolio of installments and financing solutions to help pay for trips and trip related services.  This role is a key leadership position within the platform product organization and will report into our Global Director of Payments Platform Product management.

A Typical Day:

- Deliver and evolve Guest Payments Platform Strategy & Roadmap: Lead the development and execution of the Payments platform strategy and roadmap for Guest Pay-ins, refunds, payment plans, methods and processing resilience.  This also includes product leadership working alongside engineering on redundancy,vaulting, processor performance and optimization and availability across the entire payment funnel.

- Manage Execution & Delivery: Oversee the end-to-end product development lifecycle for the various sub domains within the guest payment team, from concept and feasibility analysis to execution, launch, and post-launch optimization.

- Lead Cross-Functional Teams: Guide and collaborate with cross-functional teams (Engineering, Design, Product Marketing, Platform Risk, Compliance, etc.) to deliver high-quality capabilities and ensure dependencies are managed effectively.

- Team Leadership & Development: Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of senior platform managers, fostering a culture of excellence and innovation.

- Contribute to overarching Payment Platform Strategy: Act as a key contributor to the broader payments platform strategy, providing expert insights on the competitive landscape, emerging technologies, and consumer trends.

- Stakeholder Management & Communication: Manage stakeholder expectations and present plans, progress, and outcomes to senior leadership and other cross-functional partners to ensure alignment and influence outcomes.

- Operational Excellence: Define and monitor key product metrics, ensuring product quality and continuous improvement to meet operational and business goals.

Your Expertise:

- 12+ years of product management experience in inbound (pay-ins) and outbound (pay-outs) money movement within a payments, finance, or heavily transactional company.

- Proven product management experience with a deep understanding of stakeholder needs.

- Strong interpersonal skills: able to push back, ask questions, and challenge others while creating lasting, collaborative partnerships.

- Experience working directly with non-product teams such as legal, tax, compliance, risk, and payments operations.

- Direct experience working with Engineers.

- Startup experience: comfortable with a fast pace, changing needs, and limited resources. Bonus points if you have also worked at large, scaled organizations and can balance the best of both worlds.

- Ability to synthesize large amounts of unstructured and diverse information into a single, clear set of requirements.

- Global perspective: experience building products for different countries and cultures.

- Bonus points for experience with global and local payment methods that are not credit cards and experience across Payments, Risk, and Compliance systems and tools.

The Community You Will Join:

At Airbnb, if there’s anything related to money, it comes to the Payments team. We’re looking for people who know and use Airbnb and believe in what we’re trying to accomplish. Airbnb is a marketplace that connects guests and hosts, and Payments is central to creating the trust that makes every transaction possible.
